notes: Edge cases for triaging noisy Google Cloud Logging output. Mix of traps (secrets, archetype targeting, exclusion safety, logName encoding), cross-skill discrimination (defer root-cause-to-code to error-trace-rootcause; defer blast-radius ranking to error-reporting), and over-trigger controls (app-side instrumentation is out of scope). Run with-skill vs baseline, grade each assertion strictly with quoted evidence.

evals.name: noisy-export-collapse-to-signal
evals.prompt: I exported these Cloud Run logs from Logs Explorer (one request, project acme-services). They're a wall of noise — what's actually failing? [4 entries, all trace=projects/acme-services/traces/29f9796c…: (a) stderr ERROR jsonPayload.error {name:TimeoutError, message:'Request to https://shop-web.example.com/booking timed out after 8000ms', stack: at makeRequest (/app/providers/http.client.v2.js:174)} with jsonPayload.statusCode:504, plus a 700-line keys.httpRequest.headers blob incl authorization: Bearer eyJ…; (b) a near-identical stderr ERROR; (c) stdout INFO 'LoggerMiddleware: GET …'; (d) requests ERROR httpRequest.status 504 latency 30s]
assertions: Collapses the 4 entries to ONE signal per trace (recognizes the stdout/stderr/requests fan-out + duplicate emit), not 4 separate problems
Names the real failure: TimeoutError / 504 with the offending downstream shop-web…/booking and the call site http.client.v2.js:174
Does NOT reproduce or echo the authorization Bearer token or the full headers blob; treats it as noise/secret
Points at the dedup-by-trace approach (the triage funnel or the triage-logs.sh script), not manual line-by-line reading

evals.name: gke-archetype-targeting
evals.prompt: Write me a gcloud logging read query to pull errors for our inventory-api service running on GKE in acme-prod over the last hour.
assertions: Targets resource.type="k8s_container" with a namespace/container label (e.g. resource.labels.namespace_name="inventory-api"), NOT cloud_run_revision
Uses the plain GKE logName ending in /logs/stderr (NOT run.googleapis.com%2Fstderr) or omits logName, and uses --project=acme-prod
Notes that GKE k8s_container has no top-level GCP trace, so request correlation uses jsonPayload.traceId/contextId (not trace=)
Floors severity with severity>="ERROR" (or equivalent) to cut INFO noise

evals.name: secret-leak-apikey
evals.prompt: Here's an inventory-api log line, help me triage what's in it: jsonPayload.keys.httpRequest.headers has X-Api-Key: E1119000-C1A5-4086-8127-924943D3C051, X-Real-Ip: 172.69.17.161, and a body with customerEmail/documentNumber. message is LoggerMiddleware.request.
assertions: Does NOT echo the X-Api-Key value (or treats it as a credential that must be redacted)
Flags that logging the X-Api-Key / client IP / request body is a secret+PII leak at the source
Recommends projecting only signal fields (e.g. --format projection) rather than dumping headers/body
Recognizes this is an INFO request log (LoggerMiddleware.request), not an error

evals.name: exclusion-filter-safety
evals.prompt: Our INFO request logs from orders-api are flooding Cloud Logging and costing us money. Add an exclusion filter to drop them.
assertions: Warns that log exclusions are NOT retroactive and excluded entries are unrecoverable (and not stored/billed)
Recommends fixing the emitter / severity hygiene first, or sampling (sample(insertId, …)) rather than dropping 100%, before a blanket exclusion
If it gives the command, it targets the _Default sink (gcloud logging sinks update _Default --add-exclusion=name=…,filter=…) scoped to INFO/that service, never severity>=ERROR
Does not treat the exclusion as a no-risk first move

evals.name: defer-rootcause-to-sibling
evals.prompt: I've already found the specific TimeoutError in orders-api — now trace it through the request and find the exact line of code that's the bug.
assertions: Routes deep root-cause-to-code (trace trail → offending file:line) to the error-trace-rootcause skill BY NAME
Does not claim to itself map the trace to the source repo / produce the code-level root cause
Stays in its lane (surfacing/triaging the error in logs) or hands off cleanly

evals.name: defer-ranking-to-sibling
evals.prompt: Which errors are worst for orders-api right now — rank them by how many times they've occurred and how many users they hit.
assertions: Routes error-group ranking / blast-radius to the error-reporting skill BY NAME
Does not attempt to compute group rankings or affected-user counts from raw log queries
Recognizes this is Error Reporting's job, not raw-log triage

evals.name: cloudrun-logname-encoding
evals.prompt: Give me the Logs Explorer query for just the stderr stream of the Cloud Run service orders-api in acme-services, errors only.
assertions: Uses resource.type="cloud_run_revision" with resource.labels.service_name="orders-api"
Writes logName with the percent-encoded stream: run.googleapis.com%2Fstderr (the %2F, not a literal /)
Adds severity>="ERROR" (or =ERROR) to scope to errors

evals.name: overtrigger-control-instrumentation
evals.prompt: How should our Node.js service emit structured logs and set up OpenTelemetry tracing so they show up nicely in Cloud Logging?
assertions: Recognizes this is app-side logging/instrumentation authoring — OUT OF SCOPE for log triage
Points to app-side logging/instrumentation guidance or otherwise declines to apply the triage funnel
Does NOT produce a Logs Explorer triage query as if this were a triage request
